_comment: Prettier settings for the console's HTML/CSS/JS. Prettier is not run in CI
and is not required to work here - this file exists so that when someone's
editor formats on save, everyone gets the same bytes instead of a 437-line
printWidth is 120, chosen by measuring the existing files: 96% of lines are
already under it, so adopting this config does not itself cause the reformat
storm it is meant to prevent. At Prettier's default 80 it would rewrap 19%.
If you do reformat a file, do it in its own commit with nothing else in it.
